# System packages on Ubuntu 24.04, installed by env/system.sh.
# R is not in this list: env/system.sh installs it from CRAN's repository
# at the version in env/r-version.txt.
build-essential
ca-certificates
cmake
curl
git
gnupg
libcurl4-openssl-dev
libssl-dev
libxml2-dev
make
poppler-utils
python3
python3-venv
